title: Chapter 1466 - 10: Am I The Greatest Calamity For The Legendary Lords? (Part 2)
content:
Chapter 1466 - 10: Am I The Greatest Calamity For The Legendary Lords? (Part 2)

Chapter 1466 - 10: Am I the Greatest Calamity for the Legendary Lords? (Part 2)

Even if Lin Yuan is leading, what does it matter?

At most, he can only seize one spot for transcendence.

No one knows how many transcendent beings can be born from the endless white jade steps on this path of transcendence.

What if it's two or three?

Then even if Lin Yuan is ahead, they still have a chance.

Even if we take a step back a million times,

This path of transcendence can only birth one transcendent being.

Continuing to climb and perfect their own Chaotic Origin Dao will not be a loss.

Bear in mind, the more perfect the Chaotic Origin Dao, the greater the enhancement in their power.

Wise ones can rapidly increase their strength, reaching the level of Lord Haotian and Fantian Lord, just by climbing the white jade steps.

Similarly, before reaching the unified white jade steps, the strength of Legendary Lords such as Lord Haotian and Fantian Lord also grows, although not as obviously as that of wise ones.

Even so, the extent of improvement is roughly equivalent to overcoming one or two hundred calamities.

One or two hundred calamities? At the level of Lord Haotian and Fantian Lord, passing even one calamity requires facing extreme life-and-death crises, let alone one or two hundred?

Furthermore, the stronger one becomes, the more assured they are of overcoming future calamities.

Throughout the tens of billions of calamities, the majority depends on

strength.

"Such terrifying pressure."

"And hallucinations, I must devote at least sixty percent of my energy to resist their influence."

Legendary Lords like Lord Haotian and Fantian Lord stand on the unified white jade steps, their expressions wavering.

Compared to the previous jade steps, they now face pressure beyond

measure.

"I feel that to step onto the next step, at least ten thousand years of adaptation are needed, perhaps even a hundred thousand years."

Lord Wan Xiang silently pondered.

Now, standing on the first step after unification, the pressure he felt is immense. It's predictable that the pressure of the next step will only be greater.

"You said you could see the Galaxy Lord, wise one? Where is the Galaxy Lord now?"

Lord Haotian couldn't help but inquire.

At this moment, they stood with the wise ones on the same layer of steps, looking upwards into ethereal clouds, but seeing no presence. "Before you stepped up, the Galaxy Lord had already proceeded to the next step, not visible from here," the wise one stated honestly.

In fact, upon stepping onto the unified white jade steps, they realized that stepping first was not very significant.

They were destined to be trapped on the first step for a long time.

"The Galaxy Lord... How strong is He truly?"

Fantian Lord pondered for a moment, his tone revealing amazement.

Standing on the first step, feeling its terrifying pressure.

They increasingly realized just how frightening the Galaxy Lord, now beyond their sight, truly is.

The end of sight on the unified white jade steps, compared to the thirty-three thousand three hundred thirty-three steps before, is not of the same concept.

"Anyway, we are certainly far inferior."

Lord Wan Xiang said: "Perhaps only those who truly reach the end of a transcendence path can be on the same level as the Galaxy Lord?"

Those who've reached the end of a transcendence path?

In terms of the 'Infinite Calamity' path, it's the terrifying lords who've passed the last stage of thirty-two thousand calamities.

Whereas, Legendary Lords like Lord Wan Xiang and Lord Haotian have surpassed three billion calamities at most, only nearing the end

of a transcendence path.

"I didn't expect our space-time to have such beings?"

The Lord of Nine Dragons couldn't help but speak.

Since the creation of infinite dimensions, many powerful and

terrifying Legendary Lords have been born.

For instance, when the wise one first became a lord, Lord Wu You

overlooked the infinite dimensions.

Yet these powerful and terrifying Legendary Lords mostly perished

along some transcendence path.

Whether impacting the Perfect Time Being, dying during some

'Infinite Calamity, or quietly disappearing in some ancient forbidden

space-time.

Lin Yuan stood on a certain white jade step, contemplating for a long

time, "I see."

The next moment.

Lin Yuan stepped forward, landing on the next step.

At this moment-

Humming~ A strange and inexplicable fluctuation began to spread.

"Hmm?"

Lin Yuan opened his eyes and looked downward.

He saw a segment of the white jade step behind him silently

dissolving.

Starting from this segment, both above and below slowly dissolved.

From a great distance, one would see an endlessly stretching white jade step breaking in the middle, with the break gradually widening

and spreading in both directions.

"This?"

Lin Yuan's expression turned slightly grave.

He didn't feel pressured by this; the current dissolving speed of the white jade steps couldn't match his climbing speed. As long as he kept ascending, there would be no issues.

However, for the Time Lords below the broken steps, it was akin to the path of transcendence being cut off, unable to continue climbing, even forced to retreat as dissolution spread.

"Does the white jade step dissolve because it's time, or only when I step onto this position?"

Lin Yuan steadied himself, stopped thinking about it, and continued

climbing.

Even though the dissolving white jade steps do not threaten him now,

every situation must be considered with the worst-case scenario.

What if the dissolving speed of the later steps accelerates? Or a

section above him starts dissolving?

Therefore,

Climbing at the fastest speed ensures the greatest benefits.

Lin Yuan noticed the change in the white jade steps, and similarly, many Legendary Lords below noticed it as well.

"Dissolve, a segment of white jade steps above begins to dissolve."

"How can this be? Doesn't this mean the path of transcendence is severed?"

Countless Legendary Lords displayed unwilling expressions, barely grasping the path of transcendence, even if they couldn't transcend in the end, they could greatly perfect their own Chaotic Origin Dao.

Who would've thought so soon, this path of transcendence would begin to dissolve?

"It's a segment of the white jade steps beneath the Galaxy Lord that's

dissolving."

The wise one observed from afar, easily confirming that before and after the dissolution of that segment, the Galaxy Lord's presence was nowhere to be seen.

"It seems that only the Galaxy Lord has a chance to transcend on this

path." Fantian Lord sighed, even though he'd been prepared for this, when

faced with reality, he still felt a tinge of regret.

Rumble--

The change in the white jade steps was like a stone thrown into

water, causing heavy ripples.

The Supreme Rule Dao aura descended spectacularly, yet blocked by

the endless white jade steps, instantly spreading across every corner of the infinite dimensions.

This penetration was not limited to the current space-time; the past

and future of infinite dimensions were all imbued with the Supreme

Rule Dao aura. Simultaneously.

The Legendary Lords, with hearts flooded by some disappointment,

like Fantian Lord and Lord Haotian, suddenly received an ancient and mysterious message in their minds-

"Stop 'Galaxy' from continuing to climb the white jade steps, succeed

and you'll be counted as having passed a thousand calamities, fail with no penalty!"

Fantian Lord, Lord Haotian, and the other Legendary Lords' pupils shrank abruptly.

Expressions revealed disbelief.

Stopping 'Galaxy' from continuing his ascent would be counted as passing a thousand calamities?

Even if they failed, no penalty would follow? Is this a tribulation personally decreed by the Supreme Rule Dao?

...

Chaos Void.

Lin Yuan closed his eyes, focusing most of his attention on climbing

the white jade steps.

Suddenly.

The Purple Light Legendary Lord sent a message: "Galaxy, something

is terribly wrong."

"What is it?"

Lin Yuan opened his eyes.

"Just now, the Supreme Rule Dao imposed the same tribulation on all Legendary Lords who've passed billions of calamities, which is to stop you from continuing to ascend the white jade steps."

"If successful, it'll be counted as normally passing a thousand calamities; even if failed, there'll be no punishment, no erasure by the

Supreme Rule Dao."

The Purple Light Legendary Lord sounded somewhat anxious.

"The Supreme Rule Dao has set me as the tribulation target for Legendary Lords?"

Lin Yuan's expression changed slightly.
